summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC disclosing a routine share disposal by its CEO, Wael Sawan, on May 22, 2026. On that date, Sawan disposed of 40,000 ordinary shares at €37.170105 per share, for a total value of €1,486,804.20, on the Amsterdam exchange. The filing is a standard notification under EU and UK market abuse regimes, not indicative of a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are noted. This is an ordinary insider transaction filing; no risk-arb angle or event-driven action applies.
